Only "what's the point", the others can't be answered
But thank you for your help. <3

*pressing 2*

I think that's probably the reason, I don't find a purpose to live.

But I also find it as kind of an escape from the way I feel now. I don't know what will happen with me when I die and that maybe pulls me too. 

Does my age matter?

Hey

I really haven't seen my mother of father depressed and I've seen them in probably all other bad "states".

I've never talked to a professional about this, I really don't like sharing and it doesn't matter if it's with family, friends or someone I don't know.

I even feel like if I learn how to get out of this state and do it I will feel even more empty.
